title: certbot vars
description: Configuration variables for the Certbot Let's Encrypt ACME client component.

CERTBOT_VERSION.description: Specific version of certbot to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

CERTBOT_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for Certbot ('system' uses the OS package manager, 'libscript_native' uses isolated version directories).

CERTBOT_INSTALL_DIR.description: Custom target installation directory for isolated Certbot installations.

CERTBOT_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading Certbot release archives.

CERTBOT_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying available upstream Certbot releases.

CERT_STORE_DIR.description: Persistent read-only directory on attached data storage for storing Let's Encrypt certificates across VM instance recreations.

LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL.description: Contact email address for Let's Encrypt ACME account registration (if empty, registers with --register-unsafely-without-email).

LETSENCRYPT_RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS.description: Minimum remaining validity threshold in seconds passed to openssl x509 -checkend before renewing a certificate (default 0 means renew only when expired).

LETSENCRYPT_DISABLE_AUTO_RENEW.description: Flag (0 or 1) to disable background OS certbot timers so certificates are only renewed when expired.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_PORT.description: Global fallback TCP port for network-listening components.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Global fallback bind address for network-listening components.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global fallback UNIX domain socket path for listening components.

LIBSCRIPT_ALLOW_CERTBOT_SHIM.description: Flag (0 or 1) to allow creating a lightweight certbot CLI shim in isolated dry-run test environments.
